Legal.privacySubtitle: How Etfago protects your collaborative agreement records and private server attachments
Legal.privacySection1Text: Files and agreement documents uploaded to Etfago are stored strictly on private persistent server volumes. We never use public buckets, CDN static mirrors, or third-party cloud object storage for your private attachments. Every file access re-checks server-level authorization.
Legal.privacySection2Text: Agreement revisions and audit logs are maintained for operational consistency between invited parties. Archived agreements remain visible to existing participants but cannot be mutated.
Legal.termsSubtitle: Operational collaboration workspace rules and legal trust boundaries
Legal.termsSection1Text: Recording approval on Etfago is an operational workflow action confirming agreement between invited parties. It does not constitute a statutory electronic signature, digital certificate, or government-certified identification. Etfago does not provide legal advice.
Legal.termsSection2Text: Once a version is submitted and unanimously approved, its snapshot and content hash are immutable. Subsequent edits require a new draft and explicit re-approval by all required parties.
